{"summary":"Audit result: the plan is directionally sound but is not production-ready until its Phase 0, versioned JSON contract exposes quarantine, capabilities, schema version, and independent observation timestamps. The app must never parse human CLI output or infer that a workspace is safe to start from raw MicroSandbox lifecycle alone.

Exact MSW behavior: quarantine is recorded before credential mutation and remains even when inspection, stopping, or stopped-state proof fails. Quarantine is separate from lifecycle and blocks normal start, restart, exec/SSH-derived actions, push, and credential rebinding. Stop, status, metrics, logs, credential status, and terminal repair remain recovery-oriented capabilities where supported. GitHub operations are serialized with kernel-held locks; a verifier can retain the lock after its parent is killed. Setup interruption quarantines the workspace. Failed cleanup revokes host-write metadata first, then attempts guest-secret and Keychain removal; uncertainty fails closed. Only successful verification or a fully successful rollback clears quarantine. Existing quarantined credentials are never trusted as rollback state. The only repair path presented by the app must be terminal handoff to `msw github setup WORKSPACE OWNER/REPO`; never expose marker deletion or direct `msb` mutation.

UX and accessibility rules: give the status item a stable localized label and a dynamic value such as workspace counts, highest-priority condition, and data age. Every workspace card must be a named accessibility group while preserving its controls as separate VoiceOver targets. Use headings, predictable dev/playgrounds/personal ordering, localized labels and help for every icon-only control, explicit progress values, and focus transfer to errors, confirmations, and the invoking control on dismissal. Announce only user-requested operation start/completion/failure and newly actionable critical conditions; never announce polling or continuously changing metrics. Charts require an accessibility chart descriptor or equivalent current/minimum/maximum/unit summary. Full Keyboard Access must reach and operate every command without hover, drag, or pointer use; provide standard shortcuts for Refresh, Settings, Quit, Escape, Return, and Space, with Cancel initially focused in destructive confirmations.

Reduced-motion and status semantics: observe Reduce Motion live and remove pulsing, rotation, animated chart interpolation, and spatial transitions; use static labeled progress plus elapsed time when enabled. Also honor increased contrast and reduced transparency. Color is never the sole signal: each normal, busy, stale, unavailable, quarantined, warning, and critical state needs localized text and a distinct glyph or shape. The menu-bar item must not distinguish amber from red solely by hue. CPU and memory bars always include numeric values and units.

Localization rules: place all UI, accessibility, notification, and recovery strings in a String Catalog; use plural variants and locale-aware number, percent, byte, date, and duration formatting. Do not construct sentences from fragments. Preserve workspace IDs and CLI commands as unlocalized left-to-right technical tokens while localizing their surrounding explanation. Raw CLI stderr belongs behind a localized, redacted error summary. Layout must support right-to-left direction, long translations, and larger accessibility text without truncating state or recovery actions.

State-machine invariants: observed lifecycle, freshness, quarantine, credential health, and app operation phase are independent dimensions. Authoritative lifecycle may jump because another process can change it; optimistic operation text must not overwrite observation. A transport, parse, timeout, or schema error can produce Unknown/Unavailable or preserve a Stale snapshot, never Stopped. Quarantine dominates action availability regardless of lifecycle. Each field carries its own observed-at value; late responses are rejected by generation ID. Initial launch, wake, reconnect, and relaunch begin Unknown until a fresh baseline succeeds. Metrics become stale independently of status, and a hidden Metrics view is labeled not monitoring rather than stale. One mutation may run per workspace; global operations acquire affected workspaces in fixed order. A command exit is followed by an authoritative refresh before success is reflected. Longer-than-expected is not failure, and CLI timeouts must not be shortened below MSW’s readiness and cleanup windows.

Crash, restart, and cancellation: persist only non-sensitive preferences and sanitized completed activity. On relaunch, any recorded in-flight action becomes Outcome unknown and is reconciled through read-only telemetry; never replay it, report success, or notify from it. Launch-at-login and crash recovery must never start a VM. Do not infer lock ownership from a lingering lock file. Closing the popover must not cancel work. Native Cancel is allowed only for explicitly cancel-safe telemetry, log, metrics, and tunnel processes. Start/stop/restart and push outcomes can become uncertain if interrupted; GitHub setup interruption deliberately quarantines; backup and restore require their transactional cleanup to finish. These operations therefore need terminal handoff or a durable helper and explicit CLI cancellation contract before offering Cancel. For cancel-safe children, use a uniquely owned process group, drain bounded stdout/stderr concurrently, signal once, wait for confirmed exit, and escalate with bounded grace periods; never signal an unverified reused PID. Cancellation and normal termination must race into exactly one terminal operation result.

Error and recovery patterns: show a localized cause, affected workspace, last successful observation, safe next action, and a disclosure containing bounded redacted stderr. Retry is automatic only for idempotent reads; mutation failures require refreshed state before retry. Missing CLI/config, incompatible JSON schema, missing Keychain credential, lock busy, telemetry unavailable, quarantine, permission denial, and child termination must remain distinct errors. A nonzero exit or signal is not proof of lifecycle state. Keep other workspace cards usable after a per-workspace failure. Terminal fallback commands must be exact argv-derived commands, never shell-interpolated user input.

Notification policy: request authorization only after an explicit explanatory Settings action, request only used capabilities, and reflect later System Settings changes. Establish a fresh baseline after launch, wake, and reconnect. Notify only for deduplicated sustained unavailability, newly observed quarantine, unexpected lifecycle loss, or opted-in completion/failure of a long operation. Suppress the transition caused by the app’s own visible action, transient poll failures, sleep/offline periods, metrics thresholds, and initial discovery. Apply hysteresis and deduplicate by workspace, event, and transition generation. Notification text and deep links must contain no stderr, repository path, branch, commit, username, token, or credential metadata.

Privacy and redaction: the app must never read tokens, supply token environment variables, log process environments, persist raw command output, or place secrets in notifications, diagnostics, crash reports, analytics, or pasteboard. Redact at the capture boundary before any buffer or logger, covering GitHub token prefixes, Authorization headers, bearer/basic values, GH_TOKEN assignments, URL user-info/query secrets, and Keychain output. Use privacy-marked unified logging and bounded memory-only buffers. Arbitrary guest logs cannot be reliably sanitized, so treat them as sensitive, keep them memory-only by default, exclude them from diagnostics and notifications, and require an explicit user action to copy/export.

Production acceptance checks on macOS 26: complete all flows with VoiceOver and Full Keyboard Access from cold launch without a mouse; verify focus order, labels, announcements, chart alternatives, confirmations, and focus restoration. Toggle Reduce Motion, Differentiate Without Color, increased contrast, reduced transparency, dark mode, and larger text at runtime. Run pseudolocalized, long-string, French, and right-to-left layouts. Inject fresh, stale, partial, out-of-order, malformed, incompatible-schema, sleeping, and disconnected telemetry and confirm no false Stopped state. Exercise quarantine fixtures for pending setup, failed inspection, failed stop, SIGTERM interruption, failed cleanup, lock contention, and failed repair. Kill and relaunch the app at every operation phase and confirm no replay, duplicate child, false success, unsafe notification, or automatic VM start. Use fake executables to cover delays, hangs, signals, huge split stdout/stderr, partial JSON lines, and cancellation races. Seed every output sink with credential test strings and verify zero leakage. Verify notification denial, later permission changes, baseline suppression, deduplication, self-action suppression, and private payloads. Validate the signed/notarized LSUIElement build, launch-at-login, sleep/wake, logout/login, and repeated crash recovery. Repository evidence was cross-checked read-only against README.md, docs/MSW-CHEATSHEET.md, docs/SETUP-GUIDE.md, docs/GITHUB-SETUP.md, docs/TEST-REPORT.md, artifacts/msw-menu-bar-app-plan.html, bin/msw, and quarantine/interruption tests. No files were edited and no project-wide tests, formatters, or linters were run.","filesChanged":[]}
